feed.title: antxiko — commented disassemblies of 8-bit games
feed.subtitle: Old 8-bit binaries taken apart byte by byte and commented, with the tools to rebuild them: nothing gets claimed that the binary does not show, and the source has to give the original back, byte for byte. Right now that means 100 MSX games.

entry.title: Casio World Open: the swing, played
entry.summary: The golfer swing recorded in openMSX: the frame changes every 8 frames, and the top of the backswing only shows if the power goes past 0x40. Two GIFs on the front page, every recorded frame checked against the pieces the ROM gives for it.

entry.title: Koneko no Daibouken: the hidden screens, played
entry.summary: The two screens behind the goal house, now in openMSX: a hook on the screen change sends the kitten past the house on 2-2 and 3-3, and the game scrolls in the log in the meadow and the waterfall with their enemies. Two new GIFs, checked against the screens built from the ROM.

entry.title: Game Land: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: HOME and the second cartridge, the tablet, how the keyboard is read, the score of the games made with it that goes back to zero past 999,990, and the extra lives run and checked.

entry.title: Issun-boushi no Donnamondai: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: TAB and CAPS, the demo that plays the cartridge header, a high score that is overwritten with the wrapped score past 9,999,990 so both drop to zero, the cursor keys and joystick mixed, and the life at 10,000 run and checked.

entry.title: Youkai Yashiki: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: the five keys, F1 and the demo that plays the BIOS, a high score that is overwritten with the wrapped score past 9,999,990 so both drop to zero, the cursor keys and joystick mixed, and the lives for points that the listing promised and the game does not give.

entry.title: The Seal of Hades: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: the hidden keys and the other cartridge, a high score that is overwritten with the wrapped score past 9,999,990 so both drop to zero, the cursor keys and joystick mixed, and the extra life at 30,000 run and checked.

entry.title: The Stone of Wisdom: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: the hidden keys and the passwords that are the titles, a high score that is overwritten with the wrapped score past 9,999,990 so both drop to zero, the cursor keys and joystick mixed, and a flag at 50,000 points that nobody reads.

entry.title: Moai no Hihou: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: the stage selector and the other hidden keys in one table, crushed enemies that score with bytes read from the middle of the code (up to 16,400 instead of 100-500, run with the game routine), a score with no cap, and the cursor keys and joystick added.

entry.title: Koneko no Daibouken: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: the stage lists go on past the goal house, with two screens that appear nowhere else (a log in the meadow on 2-2 and a waterfall on 3-3, built by running the ROM), a high score that drops to zero past 9,999,990, and the cursor keys and joystick mixed.

entry.title: Iga Ninpouchou Mangetsu-jou: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: the six hidden tricks in one table, a high score that is overwritten with the wrapped score past 9,999,990 so both drop to zero, and the cursor keys and joystick mixed into another direction.

entry.title: Exoide-Z Area 5: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: TAB and CAPS on the title, a high score that is overwritten with the wrapped score past 9,999,990 so both drop to zero, and the cursor keys and joystick mixed into another direction.

entry.title: Eagle Fighter: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: no hidden keys, the extra ten points per stage added in binary so the big plane is worth 0, 10 and 20 on stages 14 to 16, the cursor keys and joystick added together, and a score with no cap.

entry.title: Shindobaddo: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: the keys at power-on, the controls, and a bug run with the game routine: past a million points, a new high score clears the top digit of both, and the score and the high score drop to 400.

entry.title: Exoide-Z: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: keys 0-7 at power-on that make the ship crash-proof, the controller chosen by the title button, and a seven-digit score that the in-game scoreboard shows with six, so a million reads 000000.

entry.title: Iga Ninpouchou: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: no hidden keys, the score cap that leaves 990,000, and the cursor keys and joystick that, used at once, send the ninja the other way (right and down go left).

entry.title: Ice World: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: the ten passwords, F1 and F2 that no text mentions, stage 00 and an extra life after stage 9, the up-left diagonal that leaves the player standing still, the cursor keys and joystick added together, and a score with no cap that goes back to zero.

entry.title: Car Fighter: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: no hidden keys, the cursor keys and the joystick that, used at once, send the car somewhere else (right and down turn left), and the score run and checked up to 999,999.

entry.title: Pachinko U.F.O.: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: a ball that drops in after the last one saves the game (but only if it pays exactly 10), GAME OVER at 9,000 balls, a wait that is not reset after being saved, and the tile that was taken for the strength turns out to be the tray of balls.

entry.title: Exciting Jockey: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: no hidden keys, the payout that loses a carry so the money goes back to zero past 999,900, and the whip queue that repeats and loses lashes with more than eight, both run and measured.

entry.title: Exciting Baseball: secrets and bugs
entry.summary: A new page with the hunt through the code: every key the game reads and none hidden, the music bug that clears a vibrato in the BIOS instead of in the channel, and the scoreboard and the end of the game run and checked.
